notes.title: Abstract Arena is in Otaku Bundle #5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29987007/90ab9b59ae6352e4b2e59f2621239ad913fffb60.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

after the first week of debupt on Steam, Abstract Arena has entered a new bundle!

Otaku Bundle #5: https://otakubundle.com/latest/bundles/otakubundle-5

This Otaku Bundle presents 7 games + Abstract Arena and its soundtrack, so don't let it go and buy it for a very cheap price :)

Thanks for reading,
Alberto Muratore and team Credici

notes.title: Abstract Arena finally released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29987007/e4e7eaedeb7ce6d9c16506c3278a386a44224e03.png[/img]

Hello everyone, today Abstract Arena is finally available on Steam!

My name is Alberto Muratore and I am the frontman of a small Italian development team called Credici. During the latest months we have been taken with launching our first PC game Abstract Arena, an action-packed 2D arena shooter set in a completely abstract context.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/678230/Abstract_Arena/
A playable demo is also available for free download!
 
Abstract Arena was born when I decided to take part to the 2016 edition of the annual game development competition organized by the forum GameMaker Italia. During the summer I kept working on it by adding features, fixing bugs and polishing imperfections, and teaming up with lots of people who did help me with aspects of the game I couldn't make by myself: such as music and sound effects, language translations or social media management.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29987007/f1eb2e14e890c8003ccb1ace72001fb5f922ee4b.png[/img]
 
In September I founded team Credici to group me and my collaborators under the same name. "Credici" is an italian word with two meanings: "trust us" and "believe in what you do" - so it perfectly fits the situation because the people involved in the project are bound together just by the will of making something great that they could be proud of. Credici is more "amateur" than "real indie": it has been really challenging to create a full game "out of nothing".

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29987007/1529962a26d86951b79048caee5a5ec9d3f893ec.png[/img]

In Abstract Arena up to 6 different ships can clash simultaneously, taking advantage of all of the unique and balanced skills each of them owns. Fast, precise, powerful: the gameplay is easy to learn but hard to master, adaptable to many play styles thanks to the variety of situations the player is brought to encounter.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29987007/0e6e640b72bad163484d7390fe950e2d4d774b78.png[/img]

[list]
[*]6 different ships with unique abilities
[*]Up to 6 challengers in the Arena simultaneously
[*]Minimal and stylish graphics
[*]Soft sci-fi music and stereo sound effects
[*]12 different gadget to use
[*]16 dynamic maps with moving obstacles
[*]Choose between free-for-all and team based matches
[*]4 game modes to play
[*]LAN play or local split-screen multiplayer
[*]Full support for x360-like controllers
[*]Achievements and unlockables
[*]Support for English, Italian, French, Spanish, German and Russian language.
[/list]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29987007/497ae1201ff43099f55343155e36a2679e10307a.png[/img]

If you want to know more about us or about Abstract Arena, you can visit our pages:

Website: http://www.abstractarena.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/abstract_arena
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/abstractarena/
Press kit: http://www.abstractarena.com/press/sheet.php?p=Abstract_Arena

Thank you for reading,
Alberto Muratore and team Credici.
